seoTitle: Video Production Services | Cambridge & London | FilmEditRun
seoDescription: Explore FilmEditRun's modular video production services across Cambridge and London: event filming, conference coverage, brand films, podcasts, and post-production.
heading: Modular *filming.* <br class="hidden sm:inline" />Agile *post-production.*
description: End-to-end production capabilities configured around your brief: from multi-camera live stage capture to precision editing, colour grading, and motion design.
processDescription: A transparent four-stage methodology built around your schedule, ensuring technical precision and narrative focus at every step.

processSteps.title: Discovery & Pre-Production
processSteps.description: We align with your team on core messaging, audience intent, and required formats. From interview preparation to shooting schedules, we plan the setup around your brief with minimal demand on your team's time.

processSteps.title: On-Location Filming
processSteps.description: Configuring single or multi-camera setups, wireless vocal audio, and clean slide integration according to the demands of your venue, ensuring speakers stay composed and look authoritative on camera.

processSteps.title: Editorial & Review
processSteps.description: Structuring your film for clarity and impact, integrating your on-brand assets, lower thirds, and colour palette. Direct review links let stakeholders leave frame-accurate feedback on the timeline, ensuring smooth internal sign-off.

processSteps.title: Versioning & Delivery
processSteps.description: Exporting finished deliverables configured for your specific channels: high-resolution widescreen films for keynotes and web, plus optional subtitled 9:16 and 1:1 cutdowns built for LinkedIn and digital campaigns.

ctaText: Tell us about your upcoming project, venue, or timeline. We configure the setup around your brief and provide a transparent quote.
